# Rayan Koussa – Full-Stack Software Engineer Portfolio

> Full-Stack Software Engineer holding a Master of Science in Hypermedia & Interactive Technologies from Paris 8 University. Specialized in high-performance web applications, real-time distributed systems, and 3D WebGL experiences with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Go, and Three.js.

## Main Pages
- [Home Page](https://rayankoussa.vercel.app/en): Interactive 3D portfolio, biography, skills, and academic timeline
- [Projects Showcase](https://rayankoussa.vercel.app/en/projects): Full-stack web applications, algorithmic trading engines, and interactive game projects
- [Contact Page](https://rayankoussa.vercel.app/en/contact): Direct message form, contact details, and resume download

## Featured Engineering Projects
- [MBTI Explorer](https://rayankoussa.vercel.app/en/projects): Interactive personality-driven location discovery platform built with React, Node.js, Express, and MySQL
- [KuCoinBot v10](https://rayankoussa.vercel.app/en/projects): High-frequency cryptocurrency scalping engine in Go featuring real-time orderbook scoring and fractional Kelly sizing
- [Super Arcade 3D Portfolio](https://rayankoussa.vercel.app/en/projects): Cyberpunk interactive portfolio built with Next.js 16, Three.js 3D WebGL Vector Core, and Framer Motion
- [HTML Semantic Indexing Engine](https://rayankoussa.vercel.app/en/projects): Semantic search engine and crawler with TF-IDF indexing relevance scoring in PHP and MySQL

## Technical Stack & Core Competencies
- Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Three.js, WebGL, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Backend: Go, Node.js, Express, PHP, RESTful APIs, WebSockets
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Oracle PL/SQL
- Architecture: Systems Programming, High-Frequency Trading Systems, Multi-threading, Network Sockets TCP/IP
